decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with 30 April 2025 (the date of the decision notice of planning application reference 25/00950/HOU).Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Section 73 applications cannot vary the original time limit).

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, Location Plan446-EX-01 Rev A446-EX-04 Rev A446-PL-01 Rev A446-PL-02 Rev A446-PL-03 Rev A446-PL-04 Rev A446-PL-05 Rev A446-PL-06 Rev A446-PL-07 Rev AReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing unless otherwise specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
description: Variation of condition 2 for ref: 25/00950/HOU to allow an increase in height to front extension and charges to all facades.
